title: rosa × waitziana var. timeroyi
intro: Rosa × waitziana var. timeroyi, commonly known as Damask rose or Rosa Damascena, is a fragrant and flowering plant species. This plant is prized for its delicate rose-petal fragrance and has been used in traditional medicine, perfumery, and culinary arts for centuries. The health benefits of Rosa Damascena include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of stress, anxiety, and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Rosa Damascena include flavonoids, carotenoids, and essential oils, such as geraniol and linalool, which exhibit therapeutic actions like calming, relaxing, and soothing effects.
